name: PIPEDA (Canada)
description: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act — Canada's federal private-sector privacy law. Controls follow the ten Fair Information Principles in Schedule 1. Representative starter catalog; refine to your organization's obligations.
authority: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC)
scope: Canadian private-sector organizations that collect, use, or disclose personal information in the course of commercial activity

families.name: Fair Information Principles
families.description: The ten principles in Schedule 1 of PIPEDA that govern the handling of personal information.

controls.name: Accountability
controls.description: The organization is responsible for personal information under its control and designates an individual (e.g. a Privacy Officer) accountable for compliance.

controls.name: Identifying Purposes
controls.description: The purposes for collecting personal information are identified at or before the time of collection.

controls.name: Consent
controls.description: The knowledge and consent of the individual are required for the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information, except where inappropriate.

controls.name: Limiting Collection
controls.description: Collection of personal information is limited to what is necessary for the identified purposes and collected by fair and lawful means.

controls.name: Limiting Use, Disclosure, and Retention
controls.description: Personal information is used or disclosed only for the purposes for which it was collected, and retained only as long as necessary.

controls.name: Accuracy
controls.description: Personal information is as accurate, complete, and up-to-date as necessary for the purposes for which it is used.

controls.name: Safeguards
controls.description: Personal information is protected by security safeguards appropriate to its sensitivity (physical, organizational, and technological).

controls.name: Openness
controls.description: The organization makes its policies and practices relating to the management of personal information readily available.

controls.name: Individual Access
controls.description: Upon request, an individual is informed of the existence, use, and disclosure of their personal information and is given access to it.

controls.name: Challenging Compliance
controls.description: An individual can address a challenge concerning compliance with the above principles to the designated accountable individual.

families.name: Breach of Security Safeguards
families.description: Mandatory breach reporting and record-keeping obligations under PIPEDA.

controls.name: Breach Reporting to OPC
controls.description: Report breaches of security safeguards involving personal information that pose a real risk of significant harm to the Privacy Commissioner.

controls.name: Breach Record-Keeping
controls.description: Maintain records of every breach of security safeguards involving personal information.
